critical_code_review_comments: maker._retry only inspects abs(px - limit) > RETRY_MAX_ATR * atr. If broker.client.best returns a px that happens to satisfy that threshold but points the wrong way (e.g. ask moved up while we want a long bid), the retry would still place at the bid; the sign is already enforced by picking bid/ask per side, so it is fine, but a comment or assertion would make the intent explicit.

funnel._row_txt uses m.get('tf', 'tf') for the regime label suffix. If callers forget to set m['tf'] the label prints 'regimen_tf' which is confusing; consider defaulting to the engine timeframe at the call site (already done in run() but not in stage2 path which also calls _row_txt with mtf=None).

funnel.overext_discard returns a reason that always includes '4H s/d' when trend_4h is None. In rich engines with no mtf (funnel_rich=True but funnel_mtf=None) this means trend_4h is always None → every stretched pair is discarded. In the current code path only Bybit has funnel_rich=True AND funnel_mtf=('4h','1h'), so it is safe; worth documenting that funnel_rich implies MTF in practice.

maker.queue_entry on REAL flow updates doc['limit_price']/sl/tp inside place(); if _retry succeeds the pending insert uses the retried values (good). The log line after insertion (line 60) prints the retried limit, which is correct. Minor: the signals note 'Orden límite maker en espera @ X' is not updated with the retried price; the later ORDER log is, but the Signal document still shows the original. Low priority.
